نرتمي (form VIII)
# نَرْتَمِي (nartamī) /nar.ta.miː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَمَى (irtamā)
# نَرْتَمِيَ (nartamiya) /nar.ta.mi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَمَى (irtamā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
